scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:wallet: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest --project=demo-parrokit emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test test/wallet.test.mjs"
scripts.test:storage: npm run build && FIREBASE_CONFIG='{"storageBucket":"demo-parrokit.appspot.com","projectId":"demo-parrokit"}' GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-parrokit node --test test/storageUsage.test.mjs
scripts.test:storageflow: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest --project=demo-parrokit emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test test/storageUsageFlow.test.mjs"
scripts.test:subwallet: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest --project=demo-parrokit emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test test/subscriptionWallet.test.mjs"
scripts.test:captions: npm run build && node --test test/captionCleanup.test.mjs test/recountScript.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run build && FIREBASE_CONFIG='{"storageBucket":"demo-parrokit.appspot.com","projectId":"demo-parrokit"}' GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-parrokit npx -y firebase-tools@latest --project=demo-parrokit emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.mjs"
